text_blocks.snippet: Turkey's annual inflation rate has eased to 35.41% in May, down from 37.86% in April and below market expectations. This marks a year-long cooling trend in consumer inflation and is the lowest level since November 2021. Monthly inflation also slowed to 1.53%, the smallest increase in five months, as price growth slowed across most sub-indexes.
